basics.name: Naoki Kimura
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate & Chief Researcher
basics.summary: Chief Researcher at LY Research and Ph.D. Candidate at The University of Tokyo. Specializing in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Silent Speech Interfaces, and AI-driven input methods. Recipient of Google PhD Fellowship and Microsoft Research Asia Fellowship.
